subject: Next steps: procurement route & security gating for AtlasHealth
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Rao <m.rao@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: procurement route & security gating for AtlasHealth

Hi Maya — really appreciated the time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side after the demo: 

- Procurement path options to decide: (1) PO + standard SOW (paperflow with your procurement team), (2) credit card / corporate card (fast, but capped monthly), or (3) cloud marketplace purchase (Azure/GCP marketplace listing) which can simplify billing and IaaS integration but sometimes adds lead time on contracting.
- Security gating you flagged: SOC 2 report, DPA signature, and a short security questionnaire (you said the network team might also want an architecture diagram).
- Timing constraints: you mentioned a Sept 15 internal deadline to present the commercial recommendation.

Ask from AtlasHealth for us: could you confirm whether procurement prefers PO or marketplace for this engagement? Also, please share the procurement contact who will own the PO/SOW (I copied procurement@atlashealth as discussed).

Attached is an initial SOW template reflecting the pilot scope we discussed and our completed SecurityQA spreadsheet with answers to the standard questions — these are draft and flexible. If procurement would prefer a shorter PSA + PO instead of a marketplace listing, we can prepare that.

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement intro (you loop procurement@atlashealth) — aim for next-week intro call
2) If PO route: we’ll send a redline-friendly SOW + standard PO instructions
3) If marketplace interest: we’ll share the partner entry checklist and expected lead time
4) We’ll coordinate SOC 2 evidence transfer via our secure portal (or signed DPA first if you need it before evidence)

I’ll hold a timeslot next Tue/Wed afternoon for a procurement sync — give me a range that works and I’ll send an invite.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment stubs: Atlas_SOW_draft.pdf (12 pages, redline-ready), SecurityQA_Answers_Atlas.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Maya Rao <m.rao@atlashealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@atlashealth.com>, Oliver Chen <oliver.chen@atlashealth.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2025 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement route & security gating for AtlasHealth

Thanks Karthik — good summary and thanks for the quick turnaround on materials. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement preference: last quarter we pushed teams to use our cloud marketplace where possible, but for integrations requiring review of security controls we often end up on PO + SOW because marketplace onboarding can add 3-4 weeks. Given our deadline (Sep 15), procurement thinks PO + SOW is the safer path unless Redwood can confirm an expedited marketplace onboarding.
- SOC 2: InfoSec wants to see the SOC 2 Type II report and a completed DPA before we share environment-level diagrams. They’ll accept the SOC 2 plus the answered questionnaire as initial evidence.
- PO specifics: procurement will need your standard PO instructions (billing address, remit, tax ID) and a point of contact for invoicing.

I’ll introduce you to Priya from procurement (cc’d procurement@atlashealth) on Monday so we can have a three-way call to align on the SOW redline process and evidence transfer. Can you confirm who on your side will own the SOW redline and invoice questions?

Best,
Maya
Maya Rao | Director, Clinical Partnerships
AtlasHealth

> Attachment note: we received the SOW PDF and the SecurityQA spreadsheet.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@atlashealth.com>, Maya Rao <m.rao@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Aug 2025 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Intro: SOW redline process & evidence handoff (AtlasHealth / Redwood)

Hi Priya + procurement team — great to meet you via email.

Looping in Lauren (Commercial Ops) who will manage the SOW redline and billing instructions, and Ben (Solutions Lead) who can answer any technical evidence questions if InfoSec requests clarifications on the SecurityQA.

Quick plan: 
- Lauren will send a redline-friendly Word SOW and our PO instructions (billing address, remit, W-9/TIN) by EOD tomorrow.
- Ben will be on the call with your team to walk through any questionnaire follow-ups and the SOC 2 artifact delivery path. We host SOC 2 evidence in a time-limited secure portal; access is tied to a signed DPA/Non-Disclosure.
- If procurement confirms PO route, please share your PO template and standard payment terms (Net30/Net45) so we align the SOW language.

Call options this week: Thu 8/28 10:00am PT or Fri 8/29 11:00am PT — I’ll calendar what works for you.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@atlashealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Aug 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood PO instructions + SOW (redline)

Hello Priya / Atlas procurement —

Per Karthik’s note, attaching the redline-friendly SOW (converted to Word) and our standard PO instructions below: 

- Remit: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Billing address: 120 Embarcadero St, San Francisco, CA 94107
- Tax ID / W-9: 12-3456789 (W-9 attached)
- Preferred payment terms: Net30 (we can agree Net45 for enterprise)
- Invoicing contact: invoices@redwoodinference.com (cc Lauren on initial invoice)

We’ll accept a PO referencing ATL-2025-0891 and the signed SOW. If you need a shorter proof-of-concept engagement, we can provide a condensed PSA + PO option.

Attachments: Atlas_SOW_draft.docx (redline-enabled), W9_Redwood.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on the call to walk through the redline process.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Procurement Team <procurement@atlashealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Rao <m.rao@atlashealth.com>
Date: Wed, 27 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood PO instructions + SOW (redline)

Hi Lauren / team — thanks for the materials and the quick turnaround. A few final items before we issue a PO: 

1) We need a signed DPA before we grant SOC 2 portal access. Please send the DPA and indicate whether you require any counter-signature from our legal team.
2) On the SOW, we’d like a 30-day cancellation clause and an explicit data retention clause for logs/LLM telemetry. Can you confirm language?
3) Payment terms: we can commit to Net30 if Redwood can accept a single PO for the pilot with an auto-renew option at the end of the initial term (we’ll negotiate SOW specifics on scope if extended).

If Redwood can provide the DPA and updated SOW redlines by EOD Friday 8/29, procurement will proceed to issue a PO the following week. Otherwise, we’ll need to push the timeline and consider marketplace route as a fallback.

Thanks,
Priya Sharma | Senior Procurement Manager
AtlasHealth

> Forwarded message included above (SOW and PO instructions).
